status.summary: Contractor reports civil-works acceptance on September 20 for the B5/B6 2.1-phase second contract. Completion is limited to civil works; equipment commissioning and operation are explicitly subsequent and unconfirmed.

locator.precision: The SASAC official account names the China Telecom Guizhou Information Park and publishes 26.38 N, 106.54 E to two decimal places. This is an approximate campus reference, not a B5/B6 building, parcel, entrance or work-extent locator. The original datum is not stated; values are retained literally without a claimed CRS conversion.
locator.identity_review: Contractor names B5/B6 in the China Telecom Cloud Computing Guizhou Information Park; the SASAC institutional report and China Telecom official social account explicitly name that same campus beside the numeric coordinates. The campus point is inherited only as campus-level context for the named civil works.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Coordinates published to 0.01 degree; datum, surveyed reference feature and measured horizontal accuracy are unknown. Rounding alone is roughly kilometre scale, and no precise building position or accuracy radius is inferred.

additions.distinctness_review: Compared against all 414 current-release project rows and their site keys: China contains only the Haidong China Mobile project, in Qinghai. No Guizhou Information Park project or site is present. Retains the stable keys of the prior held B5/B6 candidate and narrows its display name to the supported civil-works scope. Two buildings in one contract remain one project at one campus.
additions.successor_review: Contractor September 22 report explicitly dates civil-works acceptance September 20 and leaves equipment commissioning/operation subsequent. Older campus operation statements concern existing facilities; none is applied to B5/B6. September design procurements do not prove equipment installed or commissioning underway.

status.summary: Qinghai government leadership report records the September 2 inspection at the named Phase 2 construction site. This refreshes the aggregate construction observation; individual stage completion and operation remain unverified.

status_updates.identity_review: Same China Mobile Plateau Big Data Center Phase 2 in Haidong as the existing June 23 project. Existing Phase 2 stage 1 EIA reference point remains a project locator; no geometry change or new campus is implied.
status_updates.successor_review: Reviewed April near-launch statements, August report of stage-one work nearing completion, and September 2 official construction-site visit. No later primary source establishing complete operation of the full Phase 2 scope was identified.

integration_note: Action projections for root integration, not a core update definition. Completed admission requires updater support; retain civil-only status scope and approximate campus coordinate metadata.
